disciplinary_grounds.description: Certificate or registration obtained through concealment, misstatement, or misrepresentation of any material fact in the application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may revoke or suspend any certificate or registration if obtained through concealment, misstatement, or misrepresentation of any material fact in the application for such certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any law or ordinance pertaining to the business of the holder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may discipline any person as defined in Section 34-37-1 for a violation of any law or ordinance pertaining to the business of the holder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing one's certificate to be used by another person for obtaining permits or doing business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person who has obtained a certificate or registration shall allow his or her name to be used by another person, either for the purpose of obtaining permits, or doing business or work under his or her certificate or registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or allowing one's certificate to enable anyone other than the certificate holder and directly supervised employees to perform plumbing or gas fitting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person shall use nor allow their certificate to enable anyone other than the certificate holder and his or her employees directly supervised by the certificate holder to perform plumbing or gas fitting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling or transferring a certificate issued by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No certificate issued by the board can be sold or transferred. Any certificate which is misused may be revoked by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to satisfy all terms and conditions of an agreement or order with the board regarding a violation or disciplinary action.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: shall satisfy all terms and conditions of the agreement or order and shall comply with the terms of a disciplinary judgment, including the payment of all fines, fees, restitution, and penalties, before recertification is granted or renewed.

definition_quote.value: All work associated with the installation, repair, or replacement of pipes, fixtures, or other apparatus necessary either for supplying water or for removing liquid or waterborne waste located on private property. The term is also used to denote installed fixtures, backflow prevention devices, drainage, vents, and water distribution systems located on private property, and all plumbing work further defined by board rules and all codes currently adopted by the board, with the exception of work allowed by this chapter.

residential_building_unit_cap.quote: A residential jobsite shall also mean up to eight attached residential dwellings located under one roof assembly.

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: An apprentice plumber must work directly under the supervision of a journeyman or master plumber.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: shall work directly under the supervision of a journeyman or master gas fitter or plumber

apprentice_to_supervisor_ratio_regulated.quote: The board may set a ratio of apprentice plumbers and apprentice gas fitters working under the supervision of any journeyman or master plumber or gas fitter; provided, the ratio shall be not less than three apprentices to any one journeyman or master plumber or gas fitter for those individuals working on non-residential jobsites and not less that five apprentices to any one journeyman or master plumber or gas fitter for those individuals working on residential jobsites.
